_comment: Registry of tracked oils/fats. Only pure, single-source products (no blends). 'standard_pack' is the unit each is standardised to for the 'price per unit' view. 'density_kg_per_l' converts a volume price to a mass price for the 'price per metric tonne' view; mass-based fats have null density (per-kg scales straight to per-tonne).

soybean.label: Soybean (pure veg)
soybean.notes: UK 'pure vegetable oil' that is 100% soya bean oil (KTC Vegetable). Single source, NOT a rapeseed/palm blend.

palm.label: Palm
palm.notes: 100% palm frying fat block. Sold by weight.

beef_dripping.label: Beef dripping (refined)
beef_dripping.notes: Fully refined & deodorised beef dripping / tallow frying fat, sold by weight. 12.5kg is the most common single-block trade size.
